dedupe_keys.name: sl nkua seismic hazard earthquake catalogue

description: Angelos Zymvragakis and colleagues publish an earthquake catalogue for seismic-hazard modelling in Greece. Zenodo provides a CSV, README and licence text under CC BY-NC 4.0 at no cost. The catalogue extends an earlier 1900–2009 series through 2023 using ISC bulletin origins and magnitudes, with 1,788 later events added. It covers earthquakes of moment magnitude at least 4.1 at any depth and gives time, WGS84 location, focal depth, several magnitude measures and source identifiers. These event records can support hazard calibration or scenario selection for infrastructure earthquake studies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this homogenised Greek series. Differences in historic station coverage and magnitude conversion may affect temporal completeness. The catalogue does not supply ground-motion fields or damage to infrastructure. No CSV was downloaded, and event counts, magnitudes and coordinates were not independently checked.
